screening.notes: shopify-zones holds bulk batches to the same destinations checkout allows, read live from the named Shopify shipping profile ('default' = the store's General profile). Bulk orders never pass through checkout, so this check is the only place that rule is enforced for them. allowlist uses shippableStates instead; off disables screening and the console shows a warning.

carrier._note: Common carriers will not deliver alcohol to PO boxes or APO/FPO/DPO addresses. These are hard failures, not warnings.

grouping._giftMessageOptions: first = use the first non-empty message in a group and warn (W07) if others differ; block = stop the batch (E25) until they match

orderDefaults._attributeNote: Match these keys to what the storefront writes, so ShipStation and packing slips pick bulk orders up the same way as web orders.
